content.text: {"fund_name":{"value":"Quillmarsh Global Macro Fund, L.P.","citation":"Section 1.1","quote":"Quillmarsh Global Macro Fund, L.P. (the \"Fund\" or the \"Partnership\") is a limited partnership organized on October 15, 2018 under the Delaware Revised Uniform Limited Partnership Act (the \"Delaware Act\")."},"fund_domicile":{"value":"Delaware, United States","citation":"Section 1.1","quote":"Quillmarsh Global Macro Fund, L.P. (the \"Fund\" or the \"Partnership\") is a limited partnership organized on October 15, 2018 under the Delaware Revised Uniform Limited Partnership Act (the \"Delaware Act\")."},"fund_structure":{"value":"Open-end (redeemable monthly); master-feeder structure in which the Fund is a U.S. feeder investing substantially all of its assets in Quillmarsh Global Macro Master Fund, Ltd., a Cayman Islands exempted company, alongside Quillmarsh Global Macro Offshore Fund, Ltd.","citation":"Section 1.2","quote":"The Fund invests substantially all of its assets in Quillmarsh Global Macro Master Fund, Ltd., a Cayman Islands exempted company (the \"Master Fund\")."},"management_fee":{"value":"Class A: 2.0% per annum of the net asset value of each Class A capital account; Class B: 1.5% per annum of the net asset value of each Class B capital account. Payable monthly in advance as of the first Business Day of each calendar month (approximately 0.1667% and 0.125% per month, respectively), determined as of the beginning of the month before reduction for the Management Fee then being calculated and before accrual of any Incentive Allocation. The Master Fund charges no management fee in respect of the Fund's investment.","citation":"Section 5.1","quote":"The Fund pays the Investment Manager a Management Fee, monthly in advance as of the first Business Day of each calendar month, at an annual rate of 2.0% of the net asset value of each Class A capital account and 1.5% of the net asset value of each Class B capital account (approximately 0.1667% and 0.125% per month, respectively), determined as of the beginning of the month before reduction for the Management Fee then being calculated and before accrual of any Incentive Allocation."},"performance_fee":{"value":"Incentive Allocation to the General Partner of 20% of Net Profits of each Class A capital account and 17.5% of Net Profits of each Class B capital account, in each case in excess of the Loss Carryforward, made as of each fiscal year end, each Redemption Date (as to the amount redeemed) and dissolution of the Fund. Affiliated Limited Partners may be exempt. The Master Fund makes no incentive allocation in respect of the Fund.","citation":"Section 5.2","quote":"As of each fiscal year end, each Redemption Date (as to the amount redeemed) and dissolution of the Fund, 20% of the Net Profits of each Class A capital account and 17.5% of the Net Profits of each Class B capital account for the period since the last Incentive Allocation, in each case in excess of the Loss Carryforward of that capital account, is reallocated to the capital account of the General Partner."},"hurdle_rate":{"value":"NOT_APPLICABLE - the Incentive Allocation is expressly not subject to any hurdle rate, preferred return or minimum rate of return.","citation":"Section 5.2","quote":"The Incentive Allocation is not subject to any hurdle rate, preferred return or minimum rate of return."},"high_water_mark":{"value":"Yes - a loss carryforward (high water mark equivalent) applies. A Loss Carryforward memorandum account is maintained for each capital account, increased by Net Losses and decreased, but not below zero, by Net Profits; no Incentive Allocation is made until prior Net Losses have been recovered. It is perpetual - not reset at fiscal year end or otherwise - and is reduced proportionately upon a partial redemption. Each additional contribution is credited to a separate capital account with its own Loss Carryforward.","citation":"Section 5.3","quote":"A memorandum account (the \"Loss Carryforward\") is maintained for each capital account, increased by Net Losses and decreased, but not below zero, by Net Profits. Upon a partial redemption, the Loss Carryforward is reduced in the proportion that the amount redeemed bears to the capital account immediately before the redemption. The Loss Carryforward is not reset at fiscal year end or otherwise."},"minimum_initial_investment":{"value":"$1,000,000 for each class of Interests (minimum additional investment $100,000); the General Partner may accept lesser amounts in its sole discretion.","citation":"Section 1.6","quote":"The minimum initial investment is $1,000,000 for each class of Interests. The minimum additional investment is $100,000. The General Partner may accept lesser amounts in its sole discretion."},"lockup_period":{"value":"Class A: 12-month soft lock-up - redemptions as of a Redemption Date preceding the first anniversary of purchase bear an early redemption charge of 3% of the amount redeemed, retained by the Fund (first-in, first-out basis; waivable by the General Partner; not applicable to Key Person Event or compulsory redemptions). Class B: 24-month hard lock-up - may not be redeemed as of any Redemption Date preceding the second anniversary of purchase. Lock-up unchanged by the July 1, 2026 amendments.","citation":"Section 1.10","quote":"Class A Interests are subject to a 12-month soft lock-up: redemptions as of a Redemption Date preceding the first anniversary of purchase bear an early redemption charge of 3% of the amount redeemed, retained by the Fund. Class B Interests are subject to a 24-month hard lock-up and may not be redeemed as of any Redemption Date preceding the second anniversary of purchase."},"redemption_frequency":{"value":"Monthly - as of the last Business Day of each calendar month (each a \"Redemption Date\"); monthly Redemption Dates unchanged by the July 1, 2026 amendments.","citation":"Section 7.1","quote":"Subject to the lock-up described in Section 1.10, a Limited Partner may redeem all or part of its Interests as of the last Business Day of each calendar month."},"redemption_notice_days":{"value":"45 days' prior written notice to the Administrator (increased from 30 days effective July 1, 2026; applies to any Redemption Date falling on or after August 31, 2026). The 10-day notice period for redemptions following a Key Person Event under Section 4.4 is unchanged. The General Partner may waive the notice period in its sole discretion.","citation":"Section 14.1","quote":"The notice period for redemptions is increased from 30 days to 45 days. A written redemption request for any Redemption Date falling on or after August 31, 2026 must be received by the Administrator at least 45 days before that Redemption Date."},"gate_provision":{"value":"Fund-level gate of 15% of the Fund's net asset value as of each Redemption Date falling on or after July 31, 2026 (measured at the level of the Fund, not per Limited Partner). Requests exceeding the threshold may be reduced pro rata; the unsatisfied portion carries forward to the next Redemption Date without priority and remains subject to the gate unless withdrawn within 10 Business Days. The gate applies to all redemptions, including redemptions following a Key Person Event. This supersedes the prior \"no gate\" statements in Sections 1.12, 7.4 and 9.12.","citation":"Section 14.2","quote":"If aggregate redemption requests of all Limited Partners as of any Redemption Date exceed 15% of the net asset value of the Fund as of that Redemption Date, determined before giving effect to those redemptions, the General Partner may reduce each request pro rata so that aggregate redemptions equal 15% of that net asset value."},"key_man_provision":{"value":"Matthias Orlev (Founder and Chief Investment Officer) is the named key person. A \"Key Person Event\" occurs if he (a) dies, (b) is unable to perform his duties for 90 consecutive days by reason of incapacity, or (c) ceases to devote substantially all of his business time to, and to have ultimate responsibility for, the investment program of the Master Fund. The General Partner must notify each Limited Partner in writing within five Business Days, and each Limited Partner may then redeem all or part of its Interests as of either of the first two Redemption Dates following that notice on at least 10 days' prior written notice, without regard to any lock-up and without any early redemption charge; the Fund will not accept subscriptions until those Redemption Dates have passed. The departure of any other individual is not a Key Person Event. Such redemptions are subject to the 15% fund-level gate effective July 1, 2026.","citation":"Section 4.3 and Section 4.4","quote":"A \"Key Person Event\" occurs if Matthias Orlev (a) dies, (b) is unable to perform his duties for 90 consecutive days by reason of incapacity, or (c) ceases to devote substantially all of his business time to, and to have ultimate responsibility for, the investment program of the Master Fund."},"gp_commitment":{"value":"NOT_APPLICABLE - no GP, sponsor or manager commitment is required. The document discloses only a current holding of approximately $31.4 million in the Feeder Funds as of January 1, 2026 by the General Partner, Investment Manager and their principals and employees, and states expressly that none of them has committed to make or maintain any investment.","citation":"Section 1.14","quote":"None of them has committed to make or maintain any investment, and each may redeem on the terms applicable to other investors."},"fund_term":{"value":"No fixed term (perpetual) - the Fund continues until dissolved in accordance with the Partnership Agreement.","citation":"Section 1.15","quote":"The Fund has no fixed term and will continue until dissolved in accordance with the Partnership Agreement."},"auditor":{"value":"Marbeck Pennycott LLP (auditor of the Fund) and Marbeck Pennycott (Cayman), a CIMA-approved auditor (auditor of the Master Fund), effective July 1, 2026, beginning with the fiscal year ending December 31, 2026, replacing Brennick Tallow LLP and Brennick Tallow (Cayman).","citation":"Section 14.3","quote":"The General Partner has appointed Marbeck Pennycott LLP as independent auditor of the Fund, and the board of the Master Fund has appointed Marbeck Pennycott (Cayman), a CIMA-approved auditor, as auditor of the Master Fund, in each case replacing Brennick Tallow LLP and Brennick Tallow (Cayman) with effect from the Effective Date, beginning with the fiscal year ending December 31, 2026."},"administrator":{"value":"Stellmoor Fund Services Ltd., 118 Shedden Road, George Town, Grand Cayman KY1-1205, Cayman Islands - administrator of the Fund, the Master Fund and the Offshore Feeder.","citation":"Section 13.7","quote":"Stellmoor Fund Services Ltd. (the \"Administrator\") is administrator of the Fund, the Master Fund and the Offshore Feeder."},"prime_broker":{"value":"Kittering Hale Securities LLC and Mallory Quenby & Co. LLC serve as prime brokers to the Master Fund. Kittering Hale Futures LLC, an affiliate of Kittering Hale Securities LLC, acts as futures commission merchant. The Investment Manager may add or replace prime brokers without notice.","citation":"Section 13.8","quote":"Kittering Hale Securities LLC and Mallory Quenby & Co. LLC serve as prime brokers to the Master Fund, providing clearing, custody, financing and securities lending."},"legal_counsel":{"value":"Tregarth Ellingsby LLP, New York, New York - U.S. counsel to the Fund, the General Partner and the Investment Manager; Carrick Mowbray, George Town, Grand Cayman - Cayman Islands counsel to the Master Fund and the Offshore Feeder.","citation":"Section 13.10","quote":"Tregarth Ellingsby LLP, New York, New York, acts as U.S. counsel to the Fund, the General Partner and the Investment Manager. Carrick Mowbray, George Town, Grand Cayman, acts as Cayman Islands counsel to the Master Fund and the Offshore Feeder."},"mfn_election":{"value":"NOT_APPLICABLE - no most favored nation election is offered. Side letters may be entered into with particular Limited Partners and are not disclosed to other Limited Partners, who have no right to notice of, or to elect the benefit of, side letter terms granted to others.","citation":"Section 5.7","quote":"Limited Partners are not entitled to notice of, or to elect the benefit of, terms granted in a side letter to any other Limited Partner, and the Fund does not offer any most favored nation election."}}
